claims.claim: AEP expanded identified new-load additions to 69 GW through 2030, signaling unusually large power-demand growth tied to its service territories.
AEP has secured approximately 13 GW of gas-turbine capacity and is evaluating another 10 GW, indicating active supply-side positioning for load growth.

risks.risk: Converting prospective load into earnings requires generation/transmission buildout, regulatory approvals, customer commitments and capital execution.

unknowns.unknown: Composition, contractual firmness and timing profile of the full 69 GW load pipeline are not established by the retrieved release.

claims.claim: AEP raised 2026 operating EPS guidance to $6.25-$6.55 from $6.15-$6.45 after first-half performance.
Q2 operating earnings were $742M versus $766M a year earlier, while year-to-date operating earnings increased to $1.633B from $1.589B.

risks.risk: Massive load/capex opportunity can pressure affordability and financing if demand timing or regulatory recovery lags investment.

contradictions.contradiction: Full-year guidance increased despite modest year-over-year Q2 operating-earnings decline.

unknowns.unknown: Incremental returns and financing mix for the infrastructure required to serve prospective load remain uncertain.
